name: qingzhou_create_session
description: Create a task with an optional first message. Set wait=true to follow the same task across runs until its current work and accepted follow-ups and steering messages have completed and its queues are empty. stream=true adds progress events. User-input waits keep observation open. Task failure or stopping ends observation. Timeout or cancellation ends observation while the browser task continues; use the returned watch recovery call without resubmitting.

wait.description: Follow the same task across runs until its work completes and its accepted follow-up and steering queues are empty. User-input waits keep observation open; task failure or stopping ends it.

stream.description: Implies wait. Send task text, status, and input events through MCP progress notifications when a progressToken is supplied.

waitTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional total observation deadline; null waits indefinitely. timeoutSeconds bounds each browser request.

clientId.title: Clientid
clientId.description: Browser name or UUID. Required when multiple browsers are online. Offline or unknown selections never fall back to another browser.

name: qingzhou_send_message
description: Send a message to the specified task. By default, a busy task queues a follow-up for its next run. Set steer=true to guide its current run at the next safe boundary. An idle task starts with either mode. Returns deliveryMode, disposition, and clientMessageId to confirm acceptance. Set wait=true to follow the same task across runs until its work completes and its follow-up and steering queues are empty. A queued message removed before execution no longer blocks completion. stream=true emits text from the submitted message onward through MCP progress notifications. Timeout or cancellation ends observation; use the returned watch recovery call without resubmitting.

wait.description: Follow the same task across runs until its work completes and its accepted follow-up and steering queues are empty. User-input waits keep observation open; task failure or stopping ends it.

stream.description: Implies wait. Send task text, status, and input events through MCP progress notifications when a progressToken is supplied.

waitTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional total observation deadline; null waits indefinitely. timeoutSeconds bounds each browser request.

clientMessageId.description: Optional stable message ID for idempotent submission.

steer.description: Guide the current run at its next safe boundary; false queues a follow-up for the next run.

name: qingzhou_get_user_input
description: Read a task's pending question, full form fields and option values, or consent notice. Returns waitId, kind, actions, instructions, and responseTemplate for qingzhou_respond_to_user_input. Fill template placeholders with the user's answers. Native Chrome permissions return requiresUserAction and side-panel instructions. Task snapshots also include this input.

name: qingzhou_respond_to_user_input
description: Respond using the pending input's responseTemplate: fill answers keyed by field IDs with option values for choices (arrays for multi_choice), then submit; approve a completed action or application consent, or reject. Show location disclosures and obtain explicit user consent before approving with consentVersion. Native Chrome permissions require the user's click in qz. Invalid or stale replies return the current input for correction and keep the request pending.

wait.description: Follow the same task across runs until its work completes and its accepted follow-up and steering queues are empty. User-input waits keep observation open; task failure or stopping ends it.

stream.description: Implies wait. Send task text, status, and input events through MCP progress notifications when a progressToken is supplied.

waitTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional total observation deadline; null waits indefinitely. timeoutSeconds bounds each browser request.

consentVersion.description: The version returned with the location disclosure the user explicitly approved.

name: qingzhou_continue_task
description: Continue a pending confirmation after the user completes the requested action. Supply the sessionId and waitId from the current input. Use qingzhou_respond_to_user_input for forms and versioned application consent.

name: qingzhou_watch_task
description: Observe an existing task across runs until its current work and accepted follow-ups and steering messages have completed and its queues are empty, without resubmitting anything.
